meta.title: La Dolce Isola · Café, Wine Bar, Gelato in Scalea
meta.description: Bar, café, wine bar, gelateria and crêperie on the pedestrian street of Scalea. Open every day except Wednesdays, from 07:00 to 01:00. Browse the menu in six languages.

nav.home: La Dolce Isola, back to top

hero.sub: On the pedestrian street of Scalea. Open until 01:00, closed on Wednesdays.
hero.posterAlt: The blue and white majolica tile with the La Dolce Isola script

teaser.title: Browse the menu.
teaser.lead: Twenty pages, six languages, all prices.

blurb.cocktail-long-drinks: Spritz, mojito and the great classics.
blurb.gelato: Artisan gelato coppe, made to be looked at first.
blurb.selezione-vini: Whites, reds and rosés, many from Calabria.

about.body: Morning brings fresh coffee and warm cornetti. Afternoons are for artisan gelato and dolci. Evenings fill with aperitivo, Calabrian wine by the glass, and cocktails under the umbrellas.
about.barAlt: The walnut bar counter with cream tufted panels and a marble top, yellow walls
about.wineAlt: The wine corner with shelves of bottles, a tufted table and the oval La Dolce Isola plaque

aperitivo.title: The golden hour.
aperitivo.body: Spritz, cocktails and sharing boards. The right place to pause, relax and enjoy the corso of Scalea.
aperitivo.photoAlt: Aperitivo antipasti and nibbles on a wooden board

vino.title: Calabrian wines by the glass.
vino.body: A curated selection of whites, reds and rosés from Calabria. To be enjoyed slowly, at the table or at the bar.
vino.photoAlt: Three wine bottles, including a Calabrian Santa Venere dessert wine
